sentences.text: Gedung teater kota itu punya kapasitas sekitar lima ratus penonton.
sentences.en: The city theater has a capacity of about five hundred spectators.
sentences.ko: 그 시립 극장은 관객을 오백 명쯤 수용할 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Kulkas di toko Ayu sudah penuh dan tidak ada kapasitas lagi untuk minuman baru.
sentences.en: The fridge in Ayu's shop is full and has no more capacity for new drinks.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게의 냉장고는 꽉 차서 새 음료를 넣을 자리가 없어요.

sentences.text: Sutradara memutuskan untuk menghapuskan satu adegan agar pertunjukan tidak terlalu panjang.
sentences.en: The director decided to cut one scene so the show wouldn't be too long.
sentences.ko: 감독은 공연이 너무 길지 않도록 장면 하나를 없애기로 했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu berencana menghapuskan sistem utang karena banyak pelanggan lupa membayar.
sentences.en: Ayu plans to do away with the credit system because many customers forget to pay.
sentences.ko: 손님들이 자꾸 갚는 걸 잊어서 아유는 외상 제도를 없앨 생각이에요.

sentences.text: Di atas panggung, Eko bergaya seperti bangsawan tua yang sombong.
sentences.en: On stage, Eko acted like an arrogant old nobleman.
sentences.ko: 무대 위에서 에코는 거만한 늙은 귀족처럼 굴었어요.

sentences.text: Anak SMA itu suka bergaya di depan cermin kecil di toko Ayu.
sentences.en: That high school kid likes to pose in front of the little mirror in Ayu's shop.
sentences.ko: 그 고등학생은 아유 가게의 작은 거울 앞에서 폼 잡는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Latihan malam itu baru selesai pukul sebelas.
sentences.en: That night's rehearsal didn't finish until eleven.
sentences.ko: 그날 밤 연습은 열한 시가 되어서야 끝났어요.

sentences.text: Toko Ayu tutup setiap malam pukul sebelas.
sentences.en: Ayu's shop closes every night at eleven.
sentences.ko: 아유의 가게는 매일 밤 열한 시에 문을 닫아요.

sentences.text: Dalam adegan laut, perahu kertas dibuat seolah-olah mengapung di atas panggung.
sentences.en: In the sea scene, a paper boat was made to look as if it were floating on stage.
sentences.ko: 바다 장면에서 종이배가 무대 위에 떠 있는 것처럼 연출됐어요.

sentences.text: Waktu banjir datang, kardus mi instan di toko Ayu sampai mengapung di lantai.
sentences.en: When the flood came, the boxes of instant noodles in Ayu's shop were floating on the floor.
sentences.ko: 홍수가 났을 때 아유 가게의 라면 상자들이 바닥에 둥둥 떴어요.

sentences.text: Teater Eko sedang mengadakan promosi besar-besaran untuk drama musikal barunya.
sentences.en: Eko's theater is running a massive promotion for its new musical.
sentences.ko: 에코의 극단은 새 뮤지컬을 위해 대대적인 홍보를 하고 있어요.

sentences.text: Minimarket di ujung jalan sedang mengadakan diskon besar-besaran, jadi toko Ayu sepi.
sentences.en: The minimarket at the end of the street is having a huge sale, so Ayu's shop is quiet.
sentences.ko: 길 끝 편의점이 대대적인 할인을 해서 아유의 가게가 한산해요.

sentences.text: Drama itu menggambarkan tingkatan sosial di sebuah kerajaan kuno.
sentences.en: The play depicts the social hierarchy in an ancient kingdom.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 고대 왕국의 사회 계층을 그려요.

sentences.text: Ayu menyusun beras di rak berdasarkan tingkatan harga, dari yang termurah.
sentences.en: Ayu arranges the rice on the shelf by price level, starting with the cheapest.
sentences.ko: 아유는 선반에 쌀을 가장 싼 것부터 가격대별로 정리해요.

sentences.text: Penonton terharu melihat sisi manusiawi tokoh raja yang kejam itu.
sentences.en: The audience was moved to see the human side of the cruel king character.
sentences.ko: 관객들은 잔인한 왕 캐릭터의 인간적인 면을 보고 감동했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu selalu memberi utang kepada tetangga yang kesusahan karena menurutnya itu manusiawi.
sentences.en: Ayu always gives credit to neighbors in need because she thinks it's the humane thing to do.
sentences.ko: 아유는 형편이 어려운 이웃에게 늘 외상을 줘요. 그게 사람다운 일이라고 생각하거든요.

sentences.text: Guru teater Eko berusaha menanamkan disiplin sejak latihan pertama.
sentences.en: Eko's drama teacher tries to instill discipline from the very first rehearsal.
sentences.ko: 에코의 연극 선생님은 첫 연습부터 규율을 심어 주려고 애써요.

sentences.text: Ayah Ayu menanamkan kejujuran dalam berdagang sejak ia masih kecil.
sentences.en: Ayu's father instilled honesty in trading in her from when she was little.
sentences.ko: 아유의 아버지는 어릴 때부터 장사에서의 정직함을 심어 주셨어요.

sentences.text: Akhir cerita yang mengejutkan itu tidak pernah terpikirkan oleh Eko sebelumnya.
sentences.en: Eko had never thought of that surprising ending before.
sentences.ko: 그 놀라운 결말은 에코가 전에는 생각도 못 했던 거예요.

sentences.text: Ide berjualan es kopi tidak pernah terpikirkan oleh Ayu sebelum anaknya mengusulkan.
sentences.en: The idea of selling iced coffee never occurred to Ayu until her child suggested it.
sentences.ko: 아이스커피를 팔 생각은 아이가 제안하기 전까지 아유는 해 본 적이 없어요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama itu, si pedagang serakah bermimpi punya harta miliaran rupiah.
sentences.en: In the play, the greedy merchant dreams of having billions of rupiah.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 욕심 많은 상인은 수십억 루피아의 재산을 꿈꿔요.

sentences.text: Ayu heran ada orang yang mau menghabiskan miliaran rupiah hanya untuk membangun minimarket.
sentences.en: Ayu is amazed that people would spend billions of rupiah just to build a minimarket.
sentences.ko: 아유는 편의점 하나 짓는 데 수십억 루피아를 쓰는 사람들이 신기해요.

sentences.text: Malam ini adalah pertunjukan ketujuh Eko sebagai pemeran utama.
sentences.en: Tonight is Eko's seventh performance as the lead actor.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤은 에코가 주연으로 서는 일곱 번째 공연이에요.

sentences.text: Hari ini adalah hari ketujuh Ayu berjualan tanpa libur.
sentences.en: Today is Ayu's seventh day selling without a day off.
sentences.ko: 오늘은 아유가 쉬지 않고 장사한 지 일곱째 날이에요.

sentences.text: Eko membiasakan diri pemanasan suara selama setengah jam sebelum naik panggung.
sentences.en: Eko has made a habit of warming up his voice for half an hour before going on stage.
sentences.ko: 에코는 무대에 오르기 전에 30분 동안 발성 연습을 하는 습관을 들였어요.

sentences.text: Ayu ingin membiasakan anaknya membantu menghitung uang kembalian.
sentences.en: Ayu wants to get her child used to helping count the change.
sentences.ko: 아유는 아이가 거스름돈 세는 걸 돕는 데 익숙해지게 하고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Eko bangga bisa tampil di panggung legendaris tempat para aktor besar memulai karier.
sentences.en: Eko is proud to perform on the legendary stage where great actors began their careers.
sentences.ko: 에코는 위대한 배우들이 경력을 시작한 전설적인 무대에 서게 돼서 뿌듯해요.

sentences.text: Toko Ayu menjual kerupuk dari pabrik legendaris yang sudah berdiri sejak zaman kakeknya.
sentences.en: Ayu's shop sells crackers from a legendary factory that has been around since her grandfather's time.
sentences.ko: 아유의 가게는 할아버지 시절부터 있던 전설적인 공장의 크루푹을 팔아요.

sentences.text: Dalam adegan penangkapan, polisi memborgol tokoh yang diperankan Eko.
sentences.en: In the arrest scene, the police handcuff the character Eko plays.
sentences.ko: 체포 장면에서 경찰이 에코가 맡은 인물에게 수갑을 채워요.

sentences.text: Di berita, Ayu melihat polisi memborgol pencuri yang membobol toko di kampung sebelah.
sentences.en: On the news, Ayu saw police handcuff the thief who broke into a shop in the next village.
sentences.ko: 뉴스에서 아유는 옆 마을 가게를 턴 도둑에게 경찰이 수갑을 채우는 걸 봤어요.

sentences.text: Kostum ratu dalam drama itu terlihat sangat elegan di bawah lampu panggung.
sentences.en: The queen's costume in the play looked very elegant under the stage lights.
sentences.ko: 그 연극의 여왕 의상은 무대 조명 아래에서 아주 우아해 보였어요.

sentences.text: Ayu menata etalase dengan rapi agar tokonya terlihat sedikit lebih elegan.
sentences.en: Ayu arranges the display case neatly so her shop looks a bit more elegant.
sentences.ko: 아유는 가게가 조금 더 고급스러워 보이도록 진열장을 깔끔하게 정리해요.

sentences.text: Di babak kedua, Eko muncul dengan nama samaran sebagai pedagang kain.
sentences.en: In the second act, Eko appears under an assumed name as a cloth merchant.
sentences.ko: 2막에서 에코는 가명을 쓴 옷감 장수로 등장해요.

sentences.text: Pelanggan setia Ayu memakai nama samaran saat memesan lewat grup chat.
sentences.en: Ayu's loyal customer uses a nickname when ordering through the group chat.
sentences.ko: 아유의 단골손님은 단톡방에서 주문할 때 별명을 써요.

sentences.text: Pergantian babak membutuhkan pemindahan dekorasi yang cepat oleh kru panggung.
sentences.en: Changing acts requires the stage crew to move the sets quickly.
sentences.ko: 막이 바뀔 때는 무대 스태프가 세트를 빨리 옮겨야 해요.

sentences.text: Penjualan Ayu naik setelah pemindahan rak minuman ke dekat pintu.
sentences.en: Ayu's sales went up after the drinks shelf was moved near the door.
sentences.ko: 음료 진열대를 문 가까이 옮긴 뒤 아유의 매출이 올랐어요.

sentences.text: Drama sejarah itu menceritakan kehidupan warga kota setelah pengeboman saat perang.
sentences.en: The historical play tells of the townspeople's lives after the bombing during the war.
sentences.ko: 그 역사극은 전쟁 중 폭격 이후 마을 사람들의 삶을 이야기해요.

sentences.text: Ayu masih ingat cerita kakeknya tentang pengeboman kota pada masa perang.
sentences.en: Ayu still remembers her grandfather's stories about the bombing of the city during the war.
sentences.ko: 아유는 전쟁 때 도시가 폭격당했다는 할아버지 이야기를 아직 기억해요.

sentences.text: Di pintu masuk teater ada larangan memotret selama pertunjukan.
sentences.en: At the theater entrance there's a ban on taking photos during the show.
sentences.ko: 극장 입구에 공연 중 사진 촬영 금지 안내가 있어요.

sentences.text: Sejak ada larangan kantong plastik, Ayu menjual tas belanja kain.
sentences.en: Since the plastic bag ban, Ayu has been selling cloth shopping bags.
sentences.ko: 비닐봉지 금지 이후로 아유는 천 장바구니를 팔아요.

sentences.text: Eko lebih suka memerankan komedi daripada drama yang serius.
sentences.en: Eko prefers acting in comedies over serious dramas.
sentences.ko: 에코는 진지한 드라마보다 코미디 연기를 더 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Sambil menjaga toko, Ayu menonton komedi lama di ponselnya.
sentences.en: While minding the shop, Ayu watches old comedies on her phone.
sentences.ko: 가게를 보면서 아유는 휴대폰으로 옛날 코미디를 봐요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama itu, sang putri dianggap membawa aib karena menikah tanpa izin ayahnya.
sentences.en: In the play, the princess is seen as bringing shame because she married without her father's permission.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 공주는 아버지 허락 없이 결혼해서 수치를 안겼다고 여겨져요.

sentences.text: Bagi Ayu, menjual barang kedaluwarsa adalah aib bagi pedagang.
sentences.en: For Ayu, selling expired goods is a disgrace for a trader.
sentences.ko: 아유에게 유통기한 지난 물건을 파는 건 장사꾼의 수치예요.

sentences.text: Eko memerankan seorang penyidik yang sabar dalam drama detektif itu.
sentences.en: Eko plays a patient investigator in the detective play.
sentences.ko: 에코는 그 탐정극에서 침착한 수사관 역을 맡았어요.

sentences.text: Seorang penyidik datang ke toko Ayu untuk melihat rekaman kamera.
sentences.en: An investigator came to Ayu's shop to look at the camera footage.
sentences.ko: 수사관 한 명이 카메라 영상을 보러 아유의 가게에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Di akhir drama ruang sidang itu, hakim menjatuhkan hukuman berat kepada pemerkosa yang diadili.
sentences.en: At the end of the courtroom drama, the judge hands a heavy sentence to the rapist on trial.
sentences.ko: 그 법정극 마지막에 판사는 재판받는 강간범에게 중형을 선고해요.

sentences.text: Koran di toko Ayu memberitakan bahwa pemerkosa yang buron itu akhirnya ditangkap polisi.
sentences.en: The newspaper at Ayu's shop reported that the fugitive rapist was finally caught by police.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게의 신문에 도주 중이던 강간범이 마침내 경찰에 잡혔다는 기사가 났어요.

sentences.text: Drama satire itu menyindir politikus yang hanya mendekati pemilih menjelang pemilu.
sentences.en: The satirical play mocks politicians who only approach voters right before elections.
sentences.ko: 그 풍자극은 선거 직전에만 유권자에게 다가가는 정치인을 비꼬아요.

sentences.text: Menjelang pemilu, para pemilih sering membicarakan calon kepala desa di toko Ayu.
sentences.en: Before the election, voters often discuss the village head candidates in Ayu's shop.
sentences.ko: 선거를 앞두고 유권자들은 아유의 가게에서 이장 후보들 이야기를 자주 해요.

sentences.text: Properti panggung yang dipakai Eko adalah tiruan artefak dari zaman kerajaan.
sentences.en: The stage prop Eko uses is a replica of an artifact from the royal era.
sentences.ko: 에코가 쓰는 소품은 왕조 시대 유물의 모조품이에요.

sentences.text: Lemari kayu di toko Ayu sudah sangat tua, hampir seperti artefak.
sentences.en: The wooden cupboard in Ayu's shop is so old it's almost like an artifact.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게의 나무 찬장은 너무 오래돼서 거의 유물 같아요.

sentences.text: Bunyi artileri dalam adegan perang dibuat dari rekaman yang diputar keras.
sentences.en: The artillery sounds in the war scene come from a recording played loudly.
sentences.ko: 전쟁 장면의 포성은 녹음을 크게 틀어서 만든 거예요.

sentences.text: Di toko Ayu ada televisi tua yang sedang menayangkan film perang dengan suara artileri.
sentences.en: In Ayu's shop there's an old TV showing a war film with the sound of artillery.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게의 낡은 TV에서 포성이 울리는 전쟁 영화가 나오고 있었어요.

sentences.text: Kisah drama itu dimulai dengan malapetaka banjir besar yang menenggelamkan desa.
sentences.en: The play's story begins with the catastrophe of a great flood that drowned a village.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 마을을 삼킨 큰 홍수라는 재앙으로 시작해요.

sentences.text: Kebakaran pasar tahun lalu menjadi malapetaka bagi banyak pedagang, termasuk Ayu.
sentences.en: Last year's market fire was a disaster for many traders, including Ayu.
sentences.ko: 작년 시장 화재는 아유를 포함한 많은 상인들에게 재앙이었어요.

sentences.text: Kata sutradara, pertunjukan bisa selesai tepat waktu itu sudah mukjizat.
sentences.en: The director said it was a miracle the show finished on time.
sentences.ko: 감독은 공연이 제시간에 끝난 것만 해도 기적이라고 말했어요.

sentences.text: Bisa bertahan di dekat minimarket besar terasa seperti mukjizat bagi toko Ayu.
sentences.en: Surviving near a big minimarket feels like a miracle for Ayu's shop.
sentences.ko: 큰 편의점 근처에서 버티는 게 아유의 가게에는 기적처럼 느껴져요.

sentences.text: Tahun depan, teater Eko akan pentas di gelanggang olahraga yang lebih besar.
sentences.en: Next year, Eko's theater will perform in a bigger sports arena.
sentences.ko: 내년에 에코의 극단은 더 큰 체육관에서 공연할 거예요.

sentences.text: Toko Ayu ramai setiap ada pertandingan di gelanggang olahraga sebelah.
sentences.en: Ayu's shop gets busy whenever there's a match at the sports arena next door.
sentences.ko: 옆 체육관에서 경기가 있을 때마다 아유의 가게는 붐벼요.

sentences.text: Eko tidak sependapat dengan sutradara soal cara menutup babak terakhir.
sentences.en: Eko doesn't agree with the director on how to end the final act.
sentences.ko: 에코는 마지막 막을 끝내는 방식에 대해 감독과 생각이 달라요.

sentences.text: Ayu sependapat dengan suaminya bahwa harga beras tidak boleh dinaikkan dulu.
sentences.en: Ayu agrees with her husband that the price of rice shouldn't be raised yet.
sentences.ko: 아유는 아직 쌀값을 올리면 안 된다는 남편 생각에 동의해요.

sentences.text: Drama itu menjadi tontonan favorit keluarga selama libur sekolah.
sentences.en: The play became the family's favorite show during the school holidays.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 방학 동안 가족들이 가장 즐겨 보는 공연이 됐어요.

sentences.text: Pertengkaran dua pelanggan di depan toko Ayu jadi tontonan warga sekitar.
sentences.en: An argument between two customers in front of Ayu's shop became a spectacle for the neighbors.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게 앞에서 손님 둘이 다툰 게 동네 사람들의 구경거리가 됐어요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko memerankan menteri yang takut kehilangan kedudukan.
sentences.en: In the play, Eko plays a minister who is afraid of losing his position.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 자리를 잃을까 봐 두려워하는 장관 역을 맡았어요.

sentences.text: Toko Ayu punya kedudukan penting bagi warga karena buka sampai tengah malam.
sentences.en: Ayu's shop has an important place for residents because it's open until midnight.
sentences.ko: 아유의 가게는 자정까지 열어서 주민들에게 중요한 자리를 차지해요.

sentences.text: Satpam teater menangkap perusak kursi penonton setelah pertunjukan malam.
sentences.en: The theater security guard caught the person who vandalized the audience seats after the evening show.
sentences.ko: 극장 경비원이 저녁 공연 뒤 관객석을 망가뜨린 사람을 붙잡았어요.

sentences.text: Kamera toko merekam perusak spanduk di depan warung Ayu.
sentences.en: The shop camera recorded the person who damaged the banner in front of Ayu's store.
sentences.ko: 가게 카메라에 아유네 가게 앞 현수막을 망가뜨린 사람이 찍혔어요.

sentences.text: Lagu penutup drama itu dinyanyikan dengan suasana yang hampir ilahi.
sentences.en: The closing song of the play was sung in an almost divine atmosphere.
sentences.ko: 그 연극의 마지막 노래는 거의 신성한 분위기 속에서 불렸어요.

sentences.text: Nenek pelanggan Ayu percaya rezeki adalah pemberian ilahi.
sentences.en: An elderly customer of Ayu's believes that one's fortune is a divine gift.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게 단골 할머니는 생계가 신이 주신 선물이라고 믿어요.

sentences.text: Para kritikus menyebut tata panggung drama itu revolusioner.
sentences.en: Critics called the play's stage design revolutionary.
sentences.ko: 비평가들은 그 연극의 무대 연출을 혁명적이라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Bagi Ayu, sistem bayar lewat ponsel adalah perubahan revolusioner untuk toko kecil.
sentences.en: For Ayu, paying by phone is a revolutionary change for small shops.
sentences.ko: 아유에게 휴대폰 결제는 작은 가게에 혁명적인 변화예요.

sentences.text: Sebelum pentas perdana, Eko meminta restu orang tuanya.
sentences.en: Before the premiere, Eko asked for his parents' blessing.
sentences.ko: 첫 공연 전에 에코는 부모님께 축복을 청했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu membuka toko kecil itu dengan restu ibunya.
sentences.en: Ayu opened the little shop with her mother's blessing.
sentences.ko: 아유는 엄마의 허락과 응원 속에 그 작은 가게를 열었어요.

sentences.text: Sebelum tirai dibuka, kru memasang mikrofon kecil di kerah baju Eko.
sentences.en: Before the curtain opened, the crew attached a small microphone to Eko's collar.
sentences.ko: 막이 오르기 전에 스태프가 에코의 옷깃에 작은 마이크를 달았어요.

sentences.text: Anak-anak suka meminjam mikrofon mainan yang dijual di toko Ayu.
sentences.en: The kids like to borrow the toy microphone sold in Ayu's shop.
sentences.ko: 아이들은 아유 가게에서 파는 장난감 마이크를 빌려 놀기 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko berperan sebagai penyelundup yang membawa barang lewat pelabuhan.
sentences.en: In the play, Eko plays a smuggler who brings goods through the port.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 항구로 물건을 몰래 들여오는 밀수꾼 역을 해요.

sentences.text: Berita di televisi toko Ayu melaporkan penyelundup narkoba yang tertangkap di pelabuhan.
sentences.en: The news on the TV in Ayu's shop reported a drug smuggler caught at the port.
sentences.ko: 아유 가게 TV 뉴스에서 항구에서 붙잡힌 마약 밀수범 소식을 전했어요.

sentences.text: Untuk pentas besar itu, teater menambah pengamanan di setiap pintu masuk.
sentences.en: For that big show, the theater increased security at every entrance.
sentences.ko: 그 큰 공연을 위해 극장은 출입구마다 경비를 늘렸어요.

sentences.text: Sejak ada kamera, toko Ayu tidak perlu pengamanan tambahan di malam hari.
sentences.en: Since the cameras were installed, Ayu's shop doesn't need extra security at night.
sentences.ko: 카메라를 단 뒤로 아유의 가게는 밤에 경비를 더 둘 필요가 없어요.
